description: A commercial automobile policy declarations: who is insured, by whom and through which agency, for what term, the schedule of insured vehicles with each vehicle's coverages, limits and premiums, and the policy premium totals

insurer.description: Name of the insurance company issuing the policy, as printed in the page heading

policy_number.description: The number printed beside the POLICY NUMBER caption

issue_date.description: Date beside the 'Issued' caption at the top right, as MM-DD-YYYY

name.description: Agency name beside the AGENCY caption

code.description: Agency code printed under the agency name

named_insured.description: The insured business and its mailing address

address.description: Mailing address beside the ADDRESS caption, street, city, state and ZIP on one line

effective_date.description: Date the term begins, as MM-DD-YYYY

expiration_date.description: Date the term ends, as MM-DD-YYYY

vehicles.description: Every numbered item insured (vehicle or trailer) in the DESCRIPTION OF ITEM INSURED schedule, across all pages, in the order printed

item_number.description: The item number printed before the vehicle description

description.description: Year, make and model as printed, e.g. '2001 DODG RAM 3500 ST/SLT/SPT'

territory.description: Territory description printed under the territory code, e.g. a county

coverages.description: Each coverage row listed for this vehicle

coverage.description: Coverage name as printed, e.g. 'Combined Liability', 'Collision'

limit.description: Limit as printed, e.g. '$1Million ea occ' or 'Actual Cash Value - $1,000 deductible'; null if blank

premium.description: Premium for this coverage on this vehicle, in dollars

total_premium.description: The TOTAL premium for this vehicle, in dollars

lienholder.description: The lienholder named under Interested Parties, with its address; null when Interested Parties reads None

gross_vehicle_weight.description: Gross vehicle weight from the ITEM DETAILS, in pounds; null for items that state none

coverage_totals.description: The 'Totals by coverage' table: the policy-wide premium for each coverage

premium.description: Total premium for this coverage across all items, in dollars

total_policy_premium.description: TOTAL POLICY PREMIUM for the term, in dollars

paid_in_full_discount.description: PAID IN FULL DISCOUNT, in dollars, as a negative number

total_premium_if_paid_in_full.description: TOTAL POLICY PREMIUM IF PAID IN FULL, in dollars
